cover_letter_text:
Hi Fulton Hogan team,

My name's Marc. I graduated in February 2026 with an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, and I'd like to start out in a laboratory role. A traineeship where I learn the testing from the ground up, with the Certificate IV alongside, is exactly what I'm after.

On site in the Philippines I did inspections and quality checks and kept the material and progress records, so careful record keeping comes naturally. I hold a Victorian driver's licence and a White Card, and I'm happy to travel for work.

I will relocate to Brisbane for this role and can start two weeks after an offer. I have full working rights in Australia (Subclass 485 visa). Happy to chat any time.

Kind regards,
Marc Masarate
